title: Your personal vouchers
intro: Explore exclusive Clucky member offers. Claim a voucher, keep the code, and use it at checkout in store.
signInDescription: Sign in to claim and view your personal vouchers.
mineEmpty: You have not claimed any vouchers yet.
discoverEmpty: There are no personal voucher campaigns right now.
mineEmptyHint: Explore the offers and claim a voucher you love.
discoverEmptyHint: New offers will appear here when available.
howIntro: Redeem your member offer in three simple steps.
step1Text: Find a suitable voucher and choose Claim voucher.
step2Text: Find your personal QR or code under My vouchers.
step3Text: Show your code to the cashier before you pay.
securityText: The code can be redeemed at the counter without further verification. Only share it when you intend to use it.
presentCode: Scan QR or enter code at the counter
copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy the code above.
codeUnavailable: This voucher code is unavailable. Please try again.
bearerNotice: Anyone with this code can redeem it at the counter. Keep it private.
checkoutInvalid: This voucher is no longer available for the current order.
